source.rationale:
TWIN CONTRACT. dym-transform and dym-transform-partial are byte-identical apart from the `promotion` DOMAIN_PROBE entry (and two comment rules), so every behaviour that is not promotion-specific MUST hold identically on both. Ported deliberately rather than left to the twin: this repo has been bitten before by a fork asserted to be identical that had quietly drifted, and a rule proven on only one copy is a rule the other copy is free to lose. Same inputs, same expected output as dym-transform/HC-partial-lane-detected-from-central-exchange.json — if the two ever disagree, one of these two fixtures fails.

Behaviour under test: ONE body is deployed to every lane, so the lane is DETECTED rather than configured: central-exchange is the direct upstream of dym-transform-partial and belongs to the results arm of If6, while the not-found lane comes off the other arm. Its presence is what stamps probe_lane 'partial' — with identical candidate selection either way.
